title: Brazil's wind power race, 2010 to 2025
description:
Brazil made almost no wind power in 2010. By 2025 it was fourth in the world.
From 22 TWh in 2015 to 118 TWh in 2025, doubling every 4.1 years.
Try compounding yourself: https://rimilab.com/#/mba/time-value
Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
